question: Who among the following won a bronze medal at the World Athletics Championship in Paris in 2003?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anju Bobby George**__.

__
 
• **Anju Bobby George won a bronze medal at the World Athletics Championship in Paris in 2003**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anju Bobby George** is an Indian retired athlete.

 
 
• ​She won the bronze medal in the long jump.
 
• she became the first Indian athlete to win a medal in World Championships in Athletics
 
• Awards: Arjuna, Khel Ratna, Padma Shri, BBC Lifetime achievement award.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PT Usha **who hails from Kerala is an Indian track and field athlete.

 
 
• ​She is known as "Queen of Indian track and field"
 
• She was awarded Padma Shri in the year 1985.
 
 
 
• **​Seema Punia **is an Indian Disc thrower.
 
 
• ​She is known as Millennium Child".
 
• She won the gold medal at the 2000 World Junior Championships.
 
 
 
• ​**Krishna Poonia **is an International gold medalist, disc thrower, Indian track and field athlete, participated in Olympics twice.
 
 
• ​*Awards*: Arjuna, Padma Shri​
